About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Al Developer to build, maintain, and deploy modern web applications using Laravel and Al-assisted development tools. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain web applications using Laravel.
Build applications using AI coding tools.
Manage APIs, servers, and deployments.
Collaborate with the team to deliver high-quality solutions.
Requirements

3+ years of software development experience.
Strong knowledge of Laravel.
Experience with AI tools such as Cursor, Codex, or GitHub Copilot.
Knowledge of cloud deployment and server management.
Good problem-solving and communication skills.
Ability to work independently.
Benefits

Competitive market salary package.
100% Work From Home.
Fast-paced and collaborative work environment.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies.
Performance-based growth opportunities.
